Centum’s Stake: 80.5% Carrying Value: Kes 11Bn Market Opportunities 1. Significant demand for office space located within an SEZ. 2. A youthful population offering readily available skilled labour. 3. Robust business model has attracted significant investor interest to the SEZ.
data.1: Portfolio review – Two Rivers Land Company SEZ Business Model: A hub for export-oriented service enterprises ▪ TRIFIC SEZ is domiciling export-oriented service enterprises and investment companies. The enterprises within the Special Economic Zone enjoy fiscal incentives, strategic location, access to world class infrastructure and one-stop business support services. ▪ TRIFIC offers Grade A office spaces (grey box, serviced or fitted) to enterprises looking to set up in the SEZ and also offers business support services which entail facilitation of SEZA licensing, recruitment and advisory on regulatory compliance. ▪ Once fully let, the assets developed by Two Rivers Land Company SEZ are sold to long term investors at an income yield via an I-REIT. Progress ▪ TRIFIC North Tower – an existing building within the SEZ with 16,234 SQM gross lettable area – has been 88% leased. ▪ 16 SEZ license applications for various TRIFIC SEZ enterprises have been approved with 13 applications under review. This is the highest and most rapid licensing success recorded under Kenya’s SEZ regime owing to TRIFIC SEZ’s compelling value proposition and strong regulatory support. ▪ The process of establishment of a Dollar I-REIT is advanced and the TRIFIC North Tower is expected to be sold into the I-REIT upon completion of the ongoing capital raise. ▪ USD 47.5Mn mezzanine finance secured to develop a second office tower with 76,400 SQM. A pipeline of demand has been developed and pre-letting commenced. Outlook ▪ Proven Demand & Sector Fit: With the TRIFIC North Tower, we have validated strong product-market fit across target sectors and established a deep pipeline of demand for additional towers. ▪ Scalable, De-risked, Repeatable Platform: With 1.2 million sqm of gross leasable area, highly profitable unit economics, and the validation of the build–lease–exit model, we have established a 13 highly scalable, repeatable platform geared for growth.

data.item: Share Buyback Update The primary objective of the Share buyback program was to provide liquidity to the counter for value preservation, and this has largely been achieved.
data.1: ▪ Centum initiated its first buyback program from 6th Feb 2023 to 30th Sep 2024 at an offer price of Kes 9.03, and 10.6Mn shares were purchased. ▪ Following approval by the Capital Market Authority, a second buyback program commenced on 1st Oct 2024. ▪ Since the commencement of the second share buy back program, 150,800 shares have been purchased. ▪ The buyback program stabilised the share price with the volume-weighted average price (VWAP) ranging between Kes 9.66 – Kes 12.0 per share, leading to shareholder value preservation. ▪ Since its inception, a cumulative total amount of Kes 97 million has been utilized to repurchase 10.8 million shares. 21

data.item: • Portfolio companies secure debt financing to fund their business growth strategies based on their debt carrying capacities. • Centum has offered guarantees for some subsidiaries’ debt facilities (Centum RE and Two Rivers Land Co. SEZ) to enable the businesses access external financing key for implementation of value creation strategies. Both companies have sizeable asset bases and cash generating capacity to comfortably service their debts with no projected recourse to Centum. • Guaranteed debt has reduced considerably by 52% from Kes 11.3Bn to Kes 5.2Bn as Centum RE has repaid their facility from Kes 3.1Bn to Kes 1.3Bn while Two Rivers Land Co. SEZ has repaid the facility from USD 50Mn to USD 38.5Mn. These have been fully funded from the respective businesses’ cash flows. 32

data.item: Summary of Asset Revaluations and Impairments: ▪ Historically, Centum has made impairment provisions, in line with our conservative annual asset revaluation policy. ▪ A significant majority of these provisions relate to four key entities—Two Rivers Development Limited, Akiira Geothermal Ltd. (AGL), Sidian Bank (via Bakki Holdings), and Centum Business Solutions. These were non-cash accounting adjustments. ▪ Since then, a significant portion of the provisions have been recovered, reflecting successful execution of strategic repositioning, monetization, and growth initiatives.

data.item: Our impairments were not permanent losses - they were conservative reflections of market and strategic realities. Our recoveries prove the resilience of our portfolio and management
data.1: Strategic Takeaways Conservative Provisioning Enables Value Recovery and Credible Net Asset Value ▪ Annual asset revaluations under IFRS may require impairment before turnaround value is visible ▪ Most provisions were non-cash, and based on prudent assessments - not distressed write-downs ▪ Majority of material impairments have since been reversed or realized through cash exits, restructuring, or operational improvement ▪ Reflects Centum’s approach: clean up → reposition → unlock value ▪ Ongoing strategy: monetization, reinvestment in annuity-generating assets, disciplined capital allocation 35
